## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List the commands and results. For UI changes, include screenshots with private data removed. Distinguish offline tests from real game, network and physical-controller tests; name anything not tested.

## Review notes

Mention changes to persistence, credentials, dependencies, runtime boundaries or update delivery when relevant.

- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, personal account data, game files or generated app bundles.
- [ ] Third-party source retains its license and upstream attribution.
- [ ] Documentation and regression coverage reflect the behavior changed, where applicable.
